svg.text: Open Portal Remote on the phone and point it here.
Phone and PC must be on the same Wi-Fi, and this app
allowed through the firewall on Private networks.
Takes effect the next time the server starts.
Anything the phone sends lands in Inbox\.
Start Portal Remote when I sign in
Rotating the token unpairs every phone; scan the new code afterwards.
